gen-gf-baloo-2-gf-piazzolla: Round, chatty, full of breathing room. Piazzolla follows in serif, its lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals, and its e opens wide enough to feel unhurried over a full page.
gen-gf-baloo-2-gf-pridi: Soft, puffed-up letters in Baloo 2 fill the line, while Pridi's serif lowercase stands up almost capital-sized. Rounded meets refined, and it works.
gen-gf-baloo-2-gf-scope-one: Baloo 2 brings open, generous bowls that seem to fill every line it sets. Scope One's serif then steps in with a big x-height and stubby ascenders, grounding all that roundness.
gen-gf-baloo-2-gf-slabo-13px: Slabo 13px has the bookish, dignified look of a classic serif, with big open counters in its a, e and s. Beside Baloo 2's puffy headings, it keeps going without tiring.
gen-gf-baloo-2-gf-suwannaphum: Open counters that breathe into the white space define Baloo 2's headings. Suwannaphum, a serif with a tall, squared-off x-height and a wide c, gives them a dignified editorial partner.
gen-gf-baloo-bhai-2-gf-epunda-slab: Epunda Slab arrives with a visibly gaping c and tall rounded lowercase, dignified in a text serif way. Epunda Slab and Baloo Bhai 2 share that rounded height, which ties the two together.
gen-gf-baloo-bhai-2-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One is a literary classic serif with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders and descenders. Baloo Bhai 2 shouts in wide-mouthed rounds; Fauna One simply reads.
gen-gf-baloo-bhai-2-gf-hanuman: Baloo Bhai 2 sets wide-mouthed, tall-reaching rounds across the top, bold and commanding in every heading. Hanuman's high-waisted text serif sits below, refined and traditional.
gen-gf-baloo-bhai-2-gf-noticia-text: Noticia Text is a literary classic serif with generous entrances into its curves. Its lowercase fills most of the letter height, which gives Baloo Bhai 2's wide-mouthed headings a sturdy, dignified partner.
gen-gf-baloo-bhai-2-gf-pridi: Loud, round and tall: Baloo Bhai 2 stretches its wide-mouthed lowercase toward the top line with real command. Pridi's classic serif, with its proud small letters, answers quietly underneath.
